posts.author: VEDANJANAM
posts.text:
Not necessarily. A good Budha on the lagna gives a precise, articulate mind, and Ketu adds depth and quiet. A bad Budha gives a native who talks too much, and about himself. A bad Ketu adds doubt and self-negation. Low self-esteem comes only from the bad pairings. The broad results for different Ascendants are as follows:

Meṣa: Anxiety, self-doubt, nervous speech.

Vṛṣabha: A good mind with a restless, unscrupulous streak.

Mithuna: A sharp, research-minded native, quiet rather than unsure.

Karka: Worry and nervousness, redeemed by spiritual depth.

Siṃha: This is where low self-worth is most seen.

Kanyā: A brilliant analytical mind, humble but not unsure.

Tulā: Health worries and disputes shake the confidence.

Vṛścika: Intuition and mantra-śakti, with a secretive, anxious streak.

Dhanu: Work and partnership at the centre of the self. The native's confidence grows through partnership and public work, not in isolation.

Makara: Hesitancy in taking initiative.

Kumbha: Secretiveness and self-doubt. Brilliant in mathematics and logic.

Mīna: Weak speech and self-expression, though the self stays grounded.

Remedies follow the diagnosis. Strengthen a weak functional benefic; never strengthen a functional malefic. An emerald for a malefic Budha adds to the damage. For the mind, Lalitā Sahasranāma Homa or Rudra Japa Homa, with Mahāgaṇapati Homa and Navagraha Śānti. Alongside them, discipline of speech for Budha and steady japa for Ketu. Undertaken as prāyaścitta, kriyamāṇa can subdue what the chart shows.

Pranam @VEDANJANAM ji

Mercury + Ketu in Lagna → low self-confidence & self-esteem.

Requesting your classical view on this yoga and suitable remedies, please.

posts.my_take: Budha + Ketu in lagna isn't automatically low self-esteem .. depends on the lagna and whether they're good or bad there. And never strengthen a malefic Budha, no emerald for that.
